title: Tables, symbols and icons
content:
# Tables, symbols and icons

You can build a table by choosing **▦ Table** in Edit or Split view. Change the number of rows and columns, then fill in the cells. Use **Edit table** above the table in Preview or Split view to modify it later.

## Example equipment table

| Device | Status | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| :icon[server]: Server | ✅ Online | File storage |
| :icon[network]: Switch | ⚠️ Maintenance | Internal network |
| :icon[database]: Database | ✓ Ready | Knowledge index |

## Symbols

Select **Ω Symbols** in the editor toolbar. Examples: Δ, Ω, µ, ±, ≥, ≤, →, ←, ✓, ✕.

## Icons and emoji

Select **☆ Icons** to insert local vector icons, or switch to the Emoji tab. Example scalable SVG icons: :icon[star]: :icon[warning]: :icon[rocket]: :icon[book]: :icon[globe]:.

The editor stores vector icons using a plain-text token such as `:icon[server]:`, which is displayed as an SVG icon by the wiki. An emoji like 📡 or 🔒 is stored directly as text.

Click the icon next to the title to set a page-specific icon that also appears in the sidebar.

[[Editing guide|Return to editing guide]].
